$comment: Loaded by the runner with --strict-mcp-config: these are the ONLY MCP servers a night session has. Empty means none - the mail, chat and drive connectors from the user settings do not exist at night. A server listed here must also be named in adoption.json -> mcpServers or every call to it is denied. The package's own server, for a typed measure/ratchet/gate/scrub/report/explain: "abatty": { "command": "npx", "args": ["abatty", "mcp"] }, named as abatty in mcpServers.
